value.latest: Mega Zeph at the former Six Flags New Orleans was demolished on 1 Feb 2025 (WDSU, Metia Carroll: "New Orleans Six Flags beloved roller coaster demolished"), and the park-wide demolition started Nov 2024. The ways here (and the neighbouring 'The Jester' ways) still carry abandoned:attraction=roller_coaster, which implies the structure still stands. The Jester was demolished in late 2024 per Wikipedia/Coasterpedia. A local mapper may want to verify whether the track geometry still exists; if not, these ways are candidates for was:attraction or removal.
